title: Monorepos
explain: A monorepo keeps several packages in one repository so they can share code and be changed together. npm, pnpm and Yarn support this with `workspaces`, and TypeScript project references let packages build in order. Tools such as Turborepo or Nx add caching on top.
exercise: Create `packages/shared` and `packages/app`, import a function from shared in app, and build both with `tsc -b`.
tip: Every referenced project needs `composite: true`. Without it, `tsc -b` refuses to build the reference.
